Status note on the solar pump scheme

As discussed in the meeting held on 12th January, the PM-KUSUM scheme is being implemented in all talukas. So far 1,240 pumps have been sanctioned and 860 installed. The farmers are very happy with the pumps and the department is getting good feedback.

The balance pumps will be installed by March end. The agency has been asked to submit the completion report at the earliest. Funds to the tune of Rs 4.5 crore have been released till date.

The matter is put up for kind perusal and further necessary action please.
